description: Extract structured contract metadata (contracting parties, effective and termination dates, total contract value, payment terms, key deliverables, security clearances, and governing law) from unstructured B2B contracts, Statements of Work (SOWs), or RFPs into normalized JSON. This is a read-only, stateless, non-destructive extraction call (requires X-RapidAPI-Key; accepts 50 to 100,000 characters in `raw_text`, and `document_type_hint` optionally biases extraction rules toward federal RFP, MSA, SOW, or NDA conventions). Use this tool when you need general commercial or header metadata from a contract; use `extract_pricing_schedule` instead for line-by-line CLIN/rate-card tables, `audit_contract_risks` for toxic clause redlining, or `generate_compliance_matrix` for Section C/L/M requirement shredding.

raw_text.description: Raw unstructured text from a B2B contract, Master Services Agreement (MSA), Statement of Work (SOW), or Request for Proposal (RFP) between 50 and 100,000 characters.

name: parse_b2b_contract

buyer_entity.description: The organization, government authority, or enterprise issuing the RFP, tender, or legal contract.

is_awarded.description: A boolean indicating if this document is a past award (True) or an active, open bid/solicitation (False).

key_deliverables.description: A list of the main project deliverables, milestones, goods, or work products required.

submission_deadline.description: The exact deadline for submission in ISO 8601 format (e.g., 'YYYY-MM-DD' or 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ'). Must be None if missing.

total_budget_usd.description: The stated budget, maximum contract value, or total fee in USD. Must be None if no explicit financial figure is mentioned.

vendor_requirements.description: A list of strict technical, security, licensing, or compliance qualifications required from the vendor.

title: Parse B2B Contract & RFP Metadata
